steps.text: Earn the Boulder Badge from Brock in Pewter City.
Drive Team Rocket out of Mt. Moon and claim a fossil.
Earn the Cascade Badge from Misty in Cerulean City.
Visit Bill at the end of Route 25.
Board the S.S. Anne in Vermilion with Bill's ticket.
Earn the Thunder Badge from Lt. Surge in Vermilion City.
Earn the Rainbow Badge from Erika in Celadon City.
Raid the Rocket Hideout under the Celadon Game Corner.
Climb the Pokémon Tower in Lavender Town and free Mr. Fuji.
Earn the Soul Badge from Koga in Fuchsia City.
Free Silph Co. in Saffron City from Team Rocket.
Earn the Marsh Badge from Sabrina in Saffron City.
Earn the Volcano Badge from Blaine on Cinnabar Island.
Earn the Earth Badge from Giovanni in Viridian City.
Face your rival on Route 22 before Victory Road.
Defeat the Elite Four and the Champion at the Indigo Plateau.
